thread.title: Apple's News Is Not A Disaster - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)

author: Mott Capital Management
title: Apple's News Is Not A Disaster - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)
text:
Some people will scream that Apple ( AAPL ) is a disaster, I do not see it that way. I think this scenario is much better than some of the headlines we had been reading late last year regarding rumors of steep iPhone cuts . Should Apple report revenue of $84 billion based on its latest guidance , sales will be down from $88.2 billion a year ago or about 5%. Obviously not good, but not a disaster. But still, the stock price has declined 39% from its 2018 highs since early October, which seems extreme.
Additionally, Apple is showing strong service revenue growth, and although at this point it is not enough to offset the disappointing iPhone sales, current quarterly services revenue of $10.8 billion is substantial and growing very quickly. If we annualize service revenue, it would suggest Apple could do nearly $44 billion in service revenue in 2019.
AAPL data by YCharts
Services Are The Bright Spot The good news is that service revenue grew 25% versus last year to about $10.8 billion for the quarter. Should the revenue numbers Apple provided during the release remain, then services revenues increased to 12.9% of total sales during the first quarter, its largest first-quarter reading ever. Services should continue to become a more significant part of the pie at Apple, and that growth should be more linear and easier to predict. Using a regression analysis, I have projected that at its current pace of growth Apple could see its service revenue hit nearly $15.5 billion by the first quarter of 2020.
